heating_cooling: Both seasons matter: plan for winter heat loss and summer heat illness.

risks: Drought: supplies can be rationed; store water early.
Shellfish can carry biotoxins that cooking does not destroy; check state closures.
Burned areas can contaminate water supplies and system pipes; follow utility notices.
Arsenic: USGS estimates roughly 116,000 people here use private wells likely above EPA's arsenic limit (2017 model estimate). Boiling does NOT remove arsenic; test private wells.
water.drinking_water_program: Search 'California drinking water program' or ask your water utility; private well guidance: https://www.epa.gov/privatewells

note: Shellfish quarantines for biotoxins are announced by the state; never eat coastal shellfish without checking.
